name: B10-0346/2026 (S&D, Verts/ALE) – The abduction, forced conversion and child marriage of Maria Shahbaz and the protection of girls in Pakistan
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the abduction, forced conversion and child marriage of Maria Shahbaz and the protection of girls in Pakistan
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and asking Pakistan to act. It asks Pakistan to do more to stop forced conversions and child marriages, to bring back abducted girls, to punish those responsible, and to give victims shelters, legal help and counselling. It also asks the European Union to raise these issues with Pakistan and to consider withdrawing Pakistan's special trade benefits if human rights commitments are not met.

- The Parliament asks Pakistan to enforce child protection laws and investigate forced conversions and marriages.
- It affects girls from religious minorities in Pakistan, especially in Sindh province.
- Next, the EU is asked to raise the issue in trade talks with Pakistan; nothing changes automatically.
